title: SaaS, PaaS and IaaS: where your share of the responsibility shifts

videos.script: The clinic has one booking system. It could run on a virtual machine, as a function, or as a product it rents. {{models}} Each choice leaves a different security to-do list. {{lists}} Going up, the list gets lighter. It never gets empty. {{vm}} First, a virtual machine, built in a hurry. Its image is from 2017. Its admin port is open to the whole internet. And it hands out its credentials to anything that asks. {{fix}} You will find all three by asking the API, fix them, and ask again. {{function}} Then a function, on a Python version that stopped getting patches. The platform keeps it running anyway. {{saas}} Last, a rented product, with no machine and no code of yours. What is left is people and data. {{last}} Every list ends with the same two items: the data, and who can reach it. {{end}}
